limitations: Local deterministic provider is held until cancelled; this is not live-provider acceptance.
The source override is saved and removed while the worker runs. The actual mounted graph stays unchanged; activation of a new unqualified provider source is intentionally not attempted.
No browser was exercised in this runtime proof; corresponding public browser paths have separate receipts.
A single finite actual-worker run establishes these effects, not reliability statistics.
